name: Holded
description: Holded — the Spanish SMB business suite: contacts, sales and purchase documents, products, warehouses, treasury accounts and CRM funnels. REST API v1, API-key auth.
instructions:
**Getting a key**
1. Sign in to Holded and open **Configuración → Desarrolladores → API key** (Settings → Developers).
2. Generate a key and put it in `HOLDED_API_KEY`. The key belongs to the account, not to a user, and carries full access to every module you have subscribed to — treat it as a password.

**The key travels in a `key` header.** Not `Authorization`, not a query parameter. Holded's own documentation calls it simply `key`.

**One API, several modules, one path prefix each.** Invoicing lives under `/invoicing/v1`, CRM under `/crm/v1`, projects under `/projects/v1`, team under `/team/v1`. The tools below carry the right prefix per resource; a 404 on a path that looks right usually means the module is not on your plan.

**Documents are one endpoint with a type.** `/invoicing/v1/documents/{docType}` covers invoices, sales receipts, credit notes, estimates, purchase orders and supplier invoices — the `docType` path segment picks one: `invoice`, `salesreceipt`, `creditnote`, `salesorder`, `estimate`, `purchase`, `purchaseorder`, `waybill`.

**Dates are Unix timestamps in seconds**, not ISO strings, on the `starttmp`/`endtmp` filters. This catches everyone once.

**Cloud reachability**: api.holded.com is public with a valid certificate.

tools.name: holded_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts — customers, suppliers, leads — with their name, NIF/CIF, e-mail, address and the type flags that say which role they hold.

type.description: Restrict by contact type, e.g. client or supplier.

tools.name: holded_get_contact
tools.description: Read one contact in full: tax data, billing address, payment terms, default VAT rate and the notes recorded against them.

tools.name: holded_list_documents
tools.description: List documents of one type — invoices, estimates, credit notes, purchase orders — with their number, date, contact, total and payment status.

docType.description: Document type: invoice, salesreceipt, creditnote, salesorder, estimate, purchase, purchaseorder, waybill.

starttmp.description: Earliest document date as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

endtmp.description: Latest document date as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

tools.name: holded_get_document
tools.description: Read one document in full: every line with its quantity, price, discount and VAT, the totals, and the payments applied against it.

tools.name: holded_list_products
tools.description: List products and services with their SKU, name, price, cost, VAT rate and stock level.

tools.name: holded_list_warehouses
tools.description: List warehouses with their name and location, so a stock question can name the right one.

tools.name: holded_list_treasury_accounts
tools.description: List the treasury accounts (bank and cash) with their name, IBAN and current balance — the cash-position answer.

tools.name: holded_list_funnels
tools.description: List the CRM funnels with their stages, so a pipeline question knows which stages exist before asking about leads in them.

tools.name: holded_list_leads
tools.description: List CRM leads with their name, contact, value, funnel stage and expected close date — the sales-pipeline view.
